salazar2020.donor_replication: Three artificial nests; allocation of donor isolates to assays unclear; no molecular strain ID supplied.
salazar2020.medium: Acid PDA, pH4.5; cellulose dispersant; dried samples incorporated into cooled agar.
salazar2020.controls: PDA alone and PDA plus cellulose; five repetitions/treatment; no positive control.
salazar2020.time: Growth followed for five weeks; dose-response endpoint reported over this assay.
salazar2020.measurement: Four perpendicular radii; inhibition (C−T)/C ×100. IC50 and IC95 estimated with a three-parameter asymptotic exponential fit.
salazar2020.limitations: No confidence intervals supplied for fitted IC values. Preserve ppm as reported; do not silently convert to molarity. Extract and pure-compound curves differ.
salazar2020.result_locator: PDF 4–5 / printed 671–672; Figs 1–3 and results prose

howard1988terpenoids.fungus_as_reported: Mutualistic attine fungus; pure-culture identity confirmed by ant acceptance.
howard1988terpenoids.donor_replication: One laboratory colony originating in Santa Rosa, Costa Rica, 1982; no molecular strain identification.
howard1988terpenoids.medium: Potato dextrose agar; ether stock dispersed in agar, heated at 50°C for2 h and left 2 days for solvent evaporation.
howard1988terpenoids.controls: Ether-treated agar and agar-only controls; triplicate fungal cultures.
howard1988terpenoids.time: Table 1 endpoint is day 7; growth was also followed through day 28.
howard1988terpenoids.measurement: Ordinal score: 4+=no growth; 3+=25%, 2+=50%, 1+=75%, 0=100% of control growth.
howard1988terpenoids.limitations: Mapped percentages retain ordinal measurement resolution. Table concentrations take precedence over approximate method concentrations. Historical plant origins do not establish batch origin or garden exposure. Possible culture-lineage overlap with 1983 study is unverified.

pagnocca1996.fungus_as_reported: Leucocoprinus gongylophorus (syn. Rozites gongylophora), identified morphologically.
pagnocca1996.donor_replication: One laboratory nest; historical names retained, no molecular strain ID supplied.
pagnocca1996.medium: Glucose10, NaCl 5, peptone 5, malt extract 10, agar 15 g/L; 1 mL DCM stock plus9 mL medium, autoclaved120°C10 min.
pagnocca1996.controls: DCM and water controls; ten test tubes/run, assays repeated twice as worded; total independent n not resolved.
pagnocca1996.measurement: Macroscopic mycelial surface/density; Table 1 reports maximum remaining growth as percent of control.
pagnocca1996.limitations: Coarse visual endpoint; no error bars. Sesamin/epigalgravin: prose says complete inhibition, table says <20% remaining growth; retain the table bound. Unequal doses do not give a potency ranking. Names/stereochemistry require structure curation before descriptor assignment.

hubbell1983.fungus_as_reported: Attine fungus; culture identity confirmed by ant acceptance.
hubbell1983.donor_replication: One laboratory colony; species/strain not molecularly identified.
hubbell1983.medium: Slants on2% potato dextrose agar or2% cornmeal agar; exact medium assignment not specified. Crystalline epoxide mixed into hot agar after autoclaving.
hubbell1983.controls: Ten untreated slants stayed healthy and growing. Initial ether carrier was abandoned because residual ether itself harmed fungus.
hubbell1983.measurement: Number of cultures shrivelled, collapsed and brown; this is damage incidence, not percent reduction in growth.
hubbell1983.limitations: Unsuccessful recovery transfer reported without enough detail to establish a formal fungicidal endpoint; authors leave fungistatic versus fungicidal unresolved. Other-fungus claim is unnamed-species personal communication and is not transcribed as assay data. Culture-lineage overlap with 1988 is unverified.

bigi2004.donor_replication: Fungus isolated from one nest; no molecular strain ID supplied.
bigi2004.medium: Peptone5, NaCl 5, malt extract 10, glucose 10, agar 15 g/L; 1 mL DCM sample plus9 mL medium; autoclaved121°C15 min. TLC comparison reported stability after autoclaving.
bigi2004.controls: Two runs with five tubes/concentration each; DCM and water controls each showed100% growth.
bigi2004.measurement: Macroscopic mycelial surface/density; modal values of remaining growth, not continuous means.
bigi2004.limitations: Active fractions are mixtures. MFHE-9 also contains glycosylsteroids. Palmitic-acid abundance is not a pure-compound activity result. Ricinine sentence is malformed and no quantitative growth value is tabulated; retain a provisional qualitative interpretation.
bigi2004.result_locator: PDF 3–4 / printed 935–936; Tables 1–3 and results prose

boulogne2012.donor_replication: Artificial gardens; number of donor colonies not specified; morphological identification.
boulogne2012.medium: Malt extract20, peptone 5, yeast extract2 g/L; agar 20 g/L for solid assay. Freeze-dried whole plant parts added to sterilized medium.
boulogne2012.controls: Six replications/treatment; untreated medium controls. Liquid assay3 mL medium plus1 mL inoculum; final versus pre-inoculation concentration basis unclear.
boulogne2012.time: Solid area/liquid dry biomass:30 days. MTT added day 15, color scored after a further15 days.
boulogne2012.measurement: Table 3 fitted IC50/IC99 with 95% CIs; table does not explicitly disaggregate solid-area versus liquid-biomass fits. Table 2 MTT color.
boulogne2012.limitations: MTT color is a metabolic proxy; authors classify yellow as fungicidal, but no recovery-transfer assay is reported. Several IC estimates lie outside tested 500–2000 µg/mL range. Exact active molecules not established.

lobo2020papaya.donor_replication: Three artificial nests; isolate allocation and independence not specified.
lobo2020papaya.medium: Acid PDA pH4.5, cellulose dispersion; five-week growth assay. Two ethanol leaf extracts from separate collections/preparations.
lobo2020papaya.controls: Five replicates/treatment; PDA-only and PDA+cellulose controls; no positive control in vitro.
lobo2020papaya.measurement: Radial mycelial-growth inhibition; numerical results from prose, not digitized plots.
lobo2020papaya.limitations: Mixture of squalene/carpaine 1:1 is labelled0.5 mg/mL without explicit total-versus-each-component clarification. Larger combination effect alone is not a formal synergy test. Glycosides/other isolated compounds were not tested; commercial quercetin was tested.

souza2005.donor_replication: Fungus from a nest; other donor details not repeated.
souza2005.medium: Paper refers assay to Pagnocca1990 (reference37); does not repeat medium/solvent details.
souza2005.controls: Replication and controls referred to previous protocol, not restated in this paper.
souza2005.time: Not restated; cited1990 protocol reads30–35 days, not independently confirmed for this run.
souza2005.measurement: Table 3 growth inhibition at individual tested concentrations.
souza2005.limitations: Do not infer an assay for each of 18 isolated compounds: Table 3 lists only 11 plus extract. New imidazole compound 1 has no tabulated assay. Related Godoy thesis may overlap; do not count it as independent replication.
souza2005.method_locator: PDF 4 / printed 790; Fungicidal assay and plant methods

melo2020.donor_replication: Laboratory colonies; exact donor count not stated. Morphology/gongylidia and ant acceptance used for identification.
melo2020.medium: PDA; sealed dishes. Fumigation from filter paper in lid; contact treatment incorporated using1% DMSO.
melo2020.controls: Four replicates/treatment; PDA control for fumigation; PDA+1% DMSO control for contact.
melo2020.time: Seven days; citral recovery: further seven days on untreated PDA.
melo2020.measurement: Fig 2 fitted IC50 with interval endpoints shown; Fig 3 recovery growth. Preserve air versus medium volume basis.
melo2020.limitations: Contact screening dose conflict: methods1400 µL/L versus results/Fig 2 bound>1000 µL/L. Preserve reported bound. Oils are mixtures; pure compounds mostly purchased, sulcatyl acetate synthesized. Ant-mixture synergy is not fungal synergy.

sesame1990.donor_replication: One donor nest. Leaf assays repeated three times, other organs twice; ten tubes/sample as reported.
sesame1990.medium: Glucose10, NaCl 5, peptone 5, malt extract10, agar 15 g/L; autoclaved120°C15 min with extracts.
sesame1990.controls: Controls received the same amount of solvent. Extract preparation included activated-charcoal filtration.
sesame1990.measurement: Ordinal remaining growth:5+=100%,4+=80%,3+=60%,2+=40%,1+=20% or less; <1+ and >5+ retained literally.
sesame1990.limitations: Concentrations are original dry-plant-equivalent mass per medium volume, not recovered extract mass. Water stimulated growth. Sesamin/sesamine was not detected in leaves by the reported analysis; assay does not establish absence at all detection limits.

morais2012thesis.ant: Atta sexdens rubropilosa (thesis scope; donor details unresolved)
morais2012thesis.donor_replication: Donor strain/colony allocation not specified in chapter 2. Ten plates/treatment, three inoculum discs/plate; discs are nested, not30 independent plates.
morais2012thesis.medium: Hexane leaf extracts redissolved at 25/50/100 mg per mL DCM;1 mL added to 9 mL medium. Nominal final concentrations would be2.5/5/10 mg/mL, but table uses stock labels.
morais2012thesis.controls: Medium-only and medium+1 mL DCM controls. Solvent-associated reduction values7%,13%,0% also printed in Table 1; percentage denominator not explicit.
morais2012thesis.measurement: Dry-mycelial biomass reduction, Table 1; significance against solvent control indicated by asterisk.
morais2012thesis.limitations: Hold out of pooled potency models pending stock/final-dose clarification. Same percentages as2015 article abstract; treat as overlapping work. Coriander23%/27% reductions are not significant. No recovery assay supports an irreversible-killing label.

lapointe1996.fungus_as_reported: Attine symbiotic fungus; species not resolved molecularly
lapointe1996.donor_replication: Isolation established from five A.landolti colonies and one A.laevigata colony. Figures3–4 use two isolates, one per ant species; Fig 5 uses A.landolti isolate. Three plates/condition.
lapointe1996.medium: Leaves500 g blended with 500 mL water, clarified; supernatant used to prepare oatmeal agar, autoclaved.100%,50%,1% refer to homogenate dilution, not chemical concentration.
lapointe1996.controls: Nutrient agar without homogenate; daily area measurements at 27°C. Field garden measurements are separate experiments.
lapointe1996.time: Daily growth; Fig 4 through18 days; Fig 5 through16 days.
lapointe1996.measurement: Narrative/figure-supported growth direction or bounds; curves were not digitized.
lapointe1996.limitations: Unknown chemical cause; plant-equivalent stock does not give actual extract/compound concentration. Preserve cultivar and isolate. Field garden mass may also reflect reduced harvesting/nutrition.
